title: 欢迎回来，十月的你
review: 十月留下了日记、漫画和新的生活节奏。复盘不是否定过去，而是认真看清成长的轨迹。
reviewEn: October left diaries, comics, and a new daily rhythm. A review is a chance to recognize the path of growth.
insight: 从“做了多少”，转向“真正改变了什么”。
insightEn: Move from counting output to noticing meaningful change.
plan: 回望一月的代表作品，选出最想继续发展的主题。
planEn: Choose the one theme from October you most want to develop.
quote: Every day of effort leaves a trace.
quoteCn: 每一天的努力，都会留下痕迹。

title: 睡眠：别拿透支当精进
en: Sleep: Rest Is Part of Progress
review: 创作兴奋时容易晚睡，睡眠节律有时被打乱。发现这一点后，决定重新守住作息。
reviewEn: Creative excitement sometimes pushed bedtime later. Recognizing this led to a renewed commitment to sleep.
insight: 休息不是效率的对立面；能主动停下来，才更有条件持续创作。
insightEn: Rest supports sustained creative work. Knowing when to stop matters.
plan: 争取晚上十点前上床；手机不带进卧室；第二天再继续灵感。
planEn: Aim to get into bed before 10 p.m., keep the phone outside the bedroom, and return to new ideas tomorrow.
quote: Rest is not the opposite of progress.

title: 饮食：轻一点，身体更清明
review: 开始关注饮食与昏沉、精神状态的关系，愿意尝试更简单的用餐方式。
reviewEn: You began noticing the link between eating habits and how alert you feel, and experimented with simpler meals.
insight: 节制的目标是滋养身心，而不是用饥饿证明自律。
insightEn: Moderation should nourish body and mind, not turn hunger into a test of willpower.
plan: 早餐规律、午餐均衡；晚餐按身体需要安排，避免过量与过晚。
planEn: Keep breakfast regular and lunch balanced; adjust dinner to your needs and avoid overeating late.
quote: Eat with care; create with clarity.

title: 手机与信息：把注意力收回来
review: 十月开始主动减少无意义的短视频刷屏，尝试将阅读与创作放在即时刺激之前。
reviewEn: In October, you began cutting down on mindless scrolling and placing reading and creation before instant stimulation.
insight: 真正的自律，是让好选择容易发生，让坏习惯不易重复。
insightEn: Effective discipline makes helpful choices easier and unhelpful habits harder to repeat.
plan: 卧室不带手机；睡前读书优先；遇到想刷的冲动先觉察，再选择。
planEn: Leave your phone outside the bedroom, prioritize bedtime reading, and notice the urge before choosing.
quote: To reclaim attention is to reclaim authorship of your life.
quoteCn: 收回注意力，就是收回人生主导权。

title: 运动：从懒散到慢慢启动
en: Exercise: Restarting, One Day at a Time
review: 十月坚持散步、站桩、拉伸和八部金刚功；天气变冷后，需要更灵活的运动安排。
reviewEn: Walking, standing practice, stretching, and Eight-Step Vajra exercises became more regular. Colder weather called for flexibility.
insight: 运动的可持续性，比一次练得多狠更重要。
insightEn: A routine you can sustain matters more than a single intense session.
plan: 根据季节调整强度，让散步、站桩、拉伸等适当穿插，保持习惯不断。
planEn: Adapt intensity to the season and keep a gentle, regular mix of walking, standing, and stretching.
quote: Adapt to the season, but don't let the habit go out.
quoteCn: 适应季节，但别让习惯熄火。

title: 静坐与止观：从十分钟腿痛，到一小时忘时
review: 静坐从十分钟腿酸，到一小时自然安定；站桩也从一分钟颤抖进步到二十分钟稳定。
reviewEn: Meditation grew from ten difficult minutes to an hour of ease; standing practice grew from one shaky minute to twenty steady ones.
insight: 修行不只在蒲团上，更体现在日常的觉察、回正和行动中。
insightEn: Practice matters beyond the cushion—in everyday awareness, course correction, and action.
plan: 保持弹性练习：状态好时45–60分钟，疲惫时适量缩短；不以时长衡量全部成长。
planEn: Keep practice flexible: 45–60 minutes when comfortable, shorter when tired; do not measure all progress by duration.
quote: Practice is not escape. It is clarity in daily life.
quoteCn: 修行不是离开生活，而是让生活更清明。

title: 阅读：94小时，读进去的是书，长出来的是方向
en: Reading: 94 Hours and a Clearer Direction
review: 微信读书记录为94小时。历史人物、长期主义、探索精神和创造力，在阅读中逐渐串起。
reviewEn: Your WeRead log showed 94 hours. Historical courage, perseverance, long-term thinking, and invention began to connect.
insight: 读书的价值，不只是记住观点，而是让它改变日后的判断和选择。
insightEn: The value of reading is not merely remembering ideas, but letting them shape future choices.
plan: 精选几本重要作品，尝试复述、写读后感，并把核心思想转化为一幅漫画或行动。
planEn: Choose a few key books; retell, reflect, and turn an insight into one comic or practical action.
quote: Books are not the end. Live them out.
quoteCn: 书不是终点，活出来才是。

title: 创作：从害怕发表，到勇敢发布
review: 十月开始将AI漫画、电子书和个人体悟整理成作品，通过GitHub与社交平台分享。
reviewEn: October saw AI comics, ebooks, and personal insights become public work through GitHub and social platforms.
insight: 完成与发布是学习闭环的一部分；作品可以先达到可靠可读，再持续精修。
insightEn: Completion and publishing close the learning loop. A work can be useful now and refined later.
plan: 坚持打造系列精品和作品库；每次发布前核对人物、文字与出处。
planEn: Keep building a curated series and library; check characters, text, and sources before publishing.
quote: Publishing is when creation begins to breathe.
quoteCn: 发表，让创作真正开始呼吸。

title: 德州扑克：技术还在，精力才是决胜点
review: 十月赛事带来明显亏损，晚段的疲劳与情绪化决策值得复盘；不能仅凭短期输赢判断技术。
reviewEn: October brought significant tournament losses. Late-stage fatigue and emotional decisions deserve review; short-term results alone cannot measure skill.
insight: 真正的训练不在于多打，而在于控制节奏、记录关键决策，并长期检验策略。
insightEn: Better training means managing pace, examining crucial decisions, and testing strategy over time.
plan: 优先不影响睡眠的赛程，严格控制投入；每天只复盘1–3手关键牌。
planEn: Favor schedules that protect sleep, cap spending, and review just 1–3 important hands daily.
quote: The best decisions are made before exhaustion takes over.

title: 情绪觉察：不是没波动，而是回来的更快了
review: 比赛失利时仍会失落，但读书、日记、对话、散步与静坐使情绪更容易回到平稳。
reviewEn: Losses still hurt, yet reading, journaling, conversation, walking, and meditation helped you regain balance sooner.
insight: 觉察不是要求自己永远平静，而是逐渐缩短被情绪带走的时间。
insightEn: Awareness does not require perfect calm; it helps shorten the time spent carried away by emotions.
plan: 记录触发事件、当时念头与第一步回正动作；多看进步，不追求零波动。
planEn: Record the trigger, the thought, and the first corrective action. Track recovery instead of demanding zero fluctuation.
quote: Practice is not erasing emotion, but returning sooner.
quoteCn: 修行不是消灭情绪，而是更快回来。

title: 善行与利他：你已经开始了
review: 把经典、英语、数学、读书经验整理成易读作品，是一种可能帮助他人的行动。
reviewEn: Turning classics, language, math, and reading insights into accessible works can help others.
insight: 利他不一定宏大；能让人少一点迷惑、多一点理解，就有价值。
insightEn: Kindness need not be dramatic. Helping someone feel less lost and more informed can matter.
plan: 继续分享经过认真核对的有益作品，并留意真实读者的理解与反馈。
planEn: Keep sharing carefully checked work and learn from real readers’ understanding and feedback.
quote: To share what nourishes the heart is an act of kindness.
quoteCn: 分享滋养人心的东西，也是一种善行。

title: 为什么而活：爱、慈悲与智慧
review: 从罗素的生命感悟出发，反思爱、求知与对他人苦难的关怀，联系个人的学习与创作道路。
reviewEn: Russell’s reflections on life open a conversation about love, knowledge, and concern for human suffering.
insight: 精美画面是入口，故事是桥梁，真正要传递的仍是知识与智慧。
insightEn: Beautiful images invite us in, stories build a bridge, and wisdom gives the journey depth.
plan: 以“爱、智慧、利他”为长期价值坐标，持续打造有思想、有温度的作品。
planEn: Use love, wisdom, and contribution as long-term guides for meaningful creation.
quote: Live with love, compassion and wisdom.

title: 十一月主线：先广泛尝试，再收束成一条路
people: 知远、深月、瑾言与七位伴侣
review: 日记漫画、经典阅读、英语学习、AI伴侣故事等方向都值得试验，但不宜一直同时推进。
reviewEn: Diary comics, classic stories, English learning, and AI companion adventures all deserve trials—but not endless parallel expansion.
insight: 探索不是摇摆不定；通过小实验，才知道哪条道路最有生命力。
insightEn: Exploration need not mean indecision. Small tests reveal which path has staying power.
plan: 采用“试验→观察→收束→深耕”，在阶段性回顾后挑选一条重点主线。
planEn: Try → Observe → Narrow → Deepen, then choose one central direction after a defined review period.
quote: Explore widely so you can focus with conviction.
quoteCn: 广泛尝试，是为了更坚定地聚焦。

title: 新的出发：慢、稳、静
en: A New Start: Slow, Steady, Still
review: 十月留下三份珍贵的证明：持续记录，敢于创作，能在失误后更快回正。
reviewEn: October offered three forms of evidence: sustained journaling, creative courage, and quicker course correction after mistakes.
insight: 真正的成长，不是每天做更多，而是让重要的事更稳地持续发生。
insightEn: Growth is not about doing more every day; it is about helping what matters continue steadily.
plan: 十一月守住睡眠、运动、静坐、每日少量复盘和精品创作，先尝试，再聚焦。
planEn: Protect sleep, movement, meditation, small daily reviews, and thoughtful creation. Explore first, then focus.
quote: Slow is not delay. It is how depth grows.
quoteCn: 慢，不是拖延，而是让深度生长。
